title: Source/provenance immutability
objective: Make canonical role/candidate source identities lifetime-resolvable and prove immutable source resolution without changing evaluation, policy, dossier, serving, or UI semantics.
requiredVerification: acknowledge every governed implementation commit in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json
npm run transition:check after acknowledgement and before agent completion
completionEvidence: candidate source content cannot be rewritten under an existing durable source-version identity
historical candidate evidence resolves to the same exact source text/hash after later uploads or extractions
opportunityVersion source identity cannot be silently rewritten
exact source-snapshot resolver primitives exist for later deterministic and LLM extraction paths
all governed commits made during the batch are acknowledged in the transition implementation ledger
agentCompletionRule: Every committed change touching a non-governance path must be acknowledged by exact commit SHA in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json before the agent may report completion. Uncommitted governed changes fail transition control. Tests are governed changes and require explicit authorization in allowedPathPrefixes. Update RADAR_TRANSITION_CONTROL.md itself only when gate/scope/decision/invariant/exit criteria change.
scopeChangeRule: If implementation requires a path or semantic owner outside this manifest, stop first. Amend the control record/state/batch scope explicitly; do not bypass the transition verifier.
